description:
Overview


Chief of Staff – Founder’s Office (Remote) at The Flex. The role is the Founder & CEO’s strategic right hand — a trusted partner, operator, and execution force. This is a company-building position blending strategy, leadership, and action.


About The Flex


fast, seamless, and borderless. Our proprietary Property Management System (PMS) is redefining how people live and landlords operate — removing friction, reducing fees, and unlocking global mobility. We’re assembling a small, elite team of A-Players who thrive under pressure, move fast, and execute with precision. If you want to build a global business from the ground up alongside a visionary founder, this is your opportunity.


The Role


As Chief of Staff, you’ll be the Founder & CEO’s strategic right hand — a trusted partner, operator, and execution force. This isn’t a support role. It’s a company-building position that blends strategy, leadership, and action. You’ll help shape priorities, turn ideas into execution, and ensure the entire organization moves in sync as The Flex scales globally. You’ll gain exposure to every part of the business — operations, product, technology, finance, talent, and expansion — playing a pivotal role in the next phase of growth.


Key Responsibilities



  • Strategic Execution – Drive high-impact initiatives across product, operations, and expansion; translate vision into measurable outcomes.

  • Organizational Alignment – Turn strategic goals into actionable plans; ensure every team is focused on what truly matters.

  • Hiring & Talent – Partner with leadership to identify, recruit, and onboard top talent across all functions.

  • Operational Leadership – Step into critical areas to solve problems, streamline execution, and keep projects on track.

  • Global Expansion – Lead research, planning, and operational setup for new market launches.

  • Process Optimization – Build scalable systems and workflows to enhance speed, clarity, and accountability.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Act as the connective tissue between teams — ensuring communication, momentum, and alignment.

  • Founder Leverage – Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO — preparing briefs, managing priorities, and driving follow-through on key decisions.


What You Bring



  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

  • Experience in startups, consulting, investment banking, or real estate.

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to turn ambiguity into structure and action.

  • High adaptability and comfort in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • A bias for execution, relentless ownership, and resilience under pressure.


Why Join The Flex



  • High-impact partnership. Work directly with the Founder/CEO on mission-critical projects.

  • Unparalleled exposure. Influence company strategy, growth, and operations from day one.

  • Career acceleration. Launchpad to an executive role or future venture of your own.

  • Freedom & flexibility. Remote-first, outcome-driven culture.

  • Competitive rewards. Compensation + performance-based incentives tied to impact.


Do Not Apply If



  • You want a predictable 9–5 routine.

  • You prefer process over progress.

  • You’re uncomfortable with accountability or speed.

  • You’re not committed to becoming elite in your craft.


About The Flex (cont.)


We’re not building another property company. We’re building a global ecosystem for flexible living — powered by technology, automation, and ambition. If you want to work side-by-side with a founder obsessed with excellence and help shape a company that’s redefining how the world lives and moves — apply now.

title: Gerente de Departamento Pessoal
description:
Sobre a empresa

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia. Certificada pelo 5° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work. Acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries! #Vempraília!

Sobre a vaga

Garantir a gestão eficiente e estratégica dos processos trabalhistas, previdenciários e de folha de pagamento da instituição, assegurando conformidade legal, integridade das informações e excelência no atendimento a colaboradores e órgãos externos.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão da Folha de Pagamento: supervisionar todo o ciclo (lançamento, conferência, fechamento e transmissão) de forma precisa e dentro dos prazos legais. Gerenciar os KPIs da área e contribuir para melhoria continua dos dados.
  • Encargos e Obrigações Legais: assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias (e-Social periódicos, FGTS, INSS, IRRF, Reoneração de folha e demais eventos associados ao envio das declarações).
  • Gestão de dados: garantir confiabilidade dos dados gerados na área para contribuir para fechamento de resultados da companhia.
  • Administração de Benefícios: coordenar concessão e controle de benefícios (VT, VR, planos de saúde, plano odontol., entre outros oferecidos pela companhia).
  • Gestão de Ponto e Frequência: acompanhar controle de jornada, banco de horas, horas extras e ausências.
  • Admissões e Desligamentos: supervisionar processos de entrada e saída de colaboradores, garantindo conformidade documental e cálculos de rescisão.
  • Atualização Legal e Fiscal: manter-se atualizada sobre mudanças na legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e sindical, avaliando impactos e propondo adequações e atualizações continua do time.
  • Relacionamento Sindical: quando necessário, conduzir negociações, acordos e tratativas com sindicatos e entidades de classe, garantir a conformidade sindical na companhia.
  • Auditorias e Compliance: apoiar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a rastreabilidade das informações e aderência a políticas internas.
  • Gestão de Equipe: liderar, desenvolver e orientar a equipe de DP, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Integração com RH e Financeiro: alinhar dados e processos para garantir coerência entre remuneração, orçamento e políticas de pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Administração, Contabilidade, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas ou Direito do Trabalho é um diferencial.
  • Folha de pagamento (sistemas integrados e eSocial).
  • Legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal.
  • Rotinas sindicais e negociações coletivas.
  • Análise de custos de pessoal e indicadores de RH e folha de pagamento.
  • Excel avançado e ERPs de gestão de pessoas (ex: SAP).

Diferenciais

  • Percentual de erros na folha de pagamento.
  • Cumprimento de prazos legais e fiscais.
  • Redução de passivos trabalhistas.
  • Eficiência do time (tempo de processamento / volume de colaboradores).

Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

Informações adicionais

  • Pessoas bem-sucedidas nessa profissão:
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando-se à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem prioridades como o sucesso profissional e ganhos financeiros, independentemente do regime de contratação;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, com flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

title: GERENTE DE ÁREA (INCLUVISA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA) – BA
description:
Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) GERENTE não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PCD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados. Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerir de maneira estratégica, tática e operacional as responsabilidades pertinentes à sua área de atuação.
  • Assegurar o regular andamento dos processos e atividades, visando cumprir prazos, orçamento, normativos e diretrizes.
  • Liderar processos de mudança.
  • Garantir a qualidade e efetividade dos serviços prestados aos clientes.
  • Garantir os resultados e produtividade da área sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Responder pela gestão administrativa, dos recursos humanos, materiais, terceirizados e tecnológicos de sua estrutura.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação, visando o cumprimento do planejamento definido para a sua área, estabelecendo indicadores, metas e estratégias.
  • Orientar e acompanhar o cumprimento das rotinas administrativas de sua área de atuação.
  • Gerenciar os processos de trabalho definidos.
  • Auxiliar na formulação do plano operacional e orçamentário, em consonância com os planos estratégicos e táticos.
  • Responder pelo desenvolvimento de indicadores que viabilizem a análise de dados, propondo ações de melhoria desses indicadores e correção das deficiências apuradas.

Atribuições

  • Definir em conjunto com o Comitê de Administração da Unidade os tipos de serviços da rede de atenção integral à saúde no território da Unidade, conforme diretrizes definidas pela Sede, em consonância com o modelo de atenção integral à saúde da CASSI.
  • Decidir em conjunto com o Comitê de Administração da Unidade os prestadores a constituírem a rede de atenção integral à saúde, conforme regras e critérios pré-estabelecidos pela CASSI.
  • Implementar fluxos integrados de cuidado entre prestadores de diferentes níveis de atenção e a APS, assegurando a continuidade e resolutividade do cuidado prestado aos participantes.
  • Estruturar e operacionalizar a rede referenciada para atenção integral à saúde no estado, no âmbito de sua atuação, em conjunto com as demais áreas da Unidade.
  • Monitorar e avaliar a efetividade dos fluxos assistenciais estabelecidos, conforme indicadores e parâmetros definidos, adotando/propondo ações articuladas com as áreas intervenientes para melhoria dos resultados, quando necessário.
  • Definir em conjunto com o Comitê de Administração da Unidade os tipos de serviços que integrarão as linhas de cuidado, conforme diretrizes definidas pela Sede, em consonância com o modelo de atenção integral à saúde da CASSI.
  • Avaliar e decidir em conjunto com o Comitê de Administração da Unidade os prestadores a constituírem as linhas de cuidado, conforme regras e critérios pré-estabelecidos.
  • Propor fluxos assistenciais, em conjunto com as demais áreas da Unidade, entre os prestadores componentes das linhas de cuidado e a atenção primária garantindo a continuidade do cuidado ao participante para atendimento de suas necessidades de saúde.
  • Coordenar e operacionalizar em conjunto com as demais áreas a implantação das linhas de cuidado no estado, conforme diretrizes definidas pela Sede.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento das linhas de cuidado por meio de indicadores, propondo os devidos ajustes operacionais/assistenciais e/ou as substituições de prestadores quando necessário, em conjunto com as áreas intervenientes.
  • Coordenar e apoiar a implantação dos serviços contratados de atenção primária a saúde, integrando-os aos demais níveis de atenção.
  • Monitorar os níveis de serviços contratados, por meio de indicadores, (captação, acompanhamento, engajamento da população, dentre outros), no âmbito da Unidade, com as empresas de APS contratadas, visando a qualidade assistencial, promovendo os realinhamentos necessários para melhoria dos resultados.
  • Acompanhar a execução dos programas de saúde, no âmbito dos serviços parceiros de atenção primária e da rede referenciada, seguindo as estratégias definidas pela CASSI e propor medidas de melhoria dos processos, quando necessário.
  • Responder pela integração dos processos administrativos, assistenciais e regulatórios entre os serviços de atenção primária próprios e contratados.
  • Gerir o relacionamento com os participantes nos atendimentos de saúde realizados nos serviços parceiros APS.
  • Coordenar e operacionalizar o Programa de Atenção Domiciliar na Unidade.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Experiência na área de gestão em saúde.
  • Experiência gerencial de 6 meses.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Modelos de Atenção à Saúde: (Atenção Primária, Integralidade do Cuidado, Redes de Atenção à Saúde (RAS) e linhas de cuidado)
  • Gestão de Saúde Suplementar (legislação, regulação e integração entre os sistemas.)
  • Gestão de programas de saúde populacional, vigilância em saúde e gestão de doenças crônicas.
  • Gestão de processos e Monitoração de Cuidado: ( protocolos clínicos, gestão crônicos e vulneráveis.)
  • Epidemiologia e Indicadores de Saúde.
  • Gestão de Rede Credenciada: avaliação de prestadores, indicadores de desempenho e qualidade assistencial.
  • Gestão de Pessoas.
  • Sistemas de Informação em Saúde.
  • Transformação Digital em Saúde: (telemedicina, inovação tecnológica aplicada à gestão).
  • Home care e cuidados paliativos.
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office.

Informações Adicionais

  • Salário: R$ 14.445,15
  • Formato: Presencial

Benefícios

  • Cesta alimentação: R$ 498,48
  • Vale refeição/alimentação: R$ 875,82
  • Plano de saúde (opcional)
  • Previdência Privada (opcional)
  • Oferecemos licença maternidade de até 6 meses
  • Licença paternidade de até 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche

Observação

  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o modelo de contrato. As informações devem ser confirmadas durante a entrevista.
  • O candidato tem a responsabilidade legal pelas informações registradas na inscrição, podendo a CASSI, a qualquer tempo durante a seleção, exigir documentação que comprove os requisitos obrigatórios da vaga.

The Opportunity

As a SDR, you will take charge of outbound prospecting efforts, managing a pipeline of 200-250 daily activities. title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Pleno/Senior
description:
Resumo do cargo

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados deve ser capaz de criar, expandir e otimizar a arquitetura de pipelines de dados, bem como desenvolver e manter fluxos de dados de diversas áreas de nossos clientes. Este(a) profissional deve estar familiarizado(a) com conceitos e estratégias de DataOps, bem como execução de projetos gerenciados em modelo Ágil. O conhecimento de tecnologias de big data é imprescindível para esse cargo. É importante que se relacione bem com diferentes equipes - tecnologia e área de negócio principalmente - e que possa apontar oportunidades de melhoria na forma de estruturação dos dados para atingir o objetivo de análise do cliente.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar e realizar manutenção e melhoria de fluxos e dados (ETL e ELT) em casos de alta complexidade
  • Transformar dados
  • Realizar desenvolvimento, testagem, homologação, implantação, correção, entrega e automatização de testes em rotinas e processos complexos
  • Utilizar de ambientes Hadoop, Spark e estruturas Cloud (Azure, AWS e GCP) para construção e execução dos pipelines de dados
  • Participar de reuniões com equipe e clientes e das cerimônias propostas pela gestão de projetos ágeis
  • Interagir com áreas de negócio complexas para validação das entregas e realização de possíveis ajustes para o acompanhamento de Engenheiro(a) de Dados intermediários(as)
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias em processos, bem como desenhar e implementar as soluções propostas como: automação de processos manuais, otimização de data delivery, melhoria de arquitetura para aumento de desempenho e outras
  • Criar e melhorar continuamente a arquitetura de pipelines de dados
  • Combinar diversas bases de dados grandes e complexas para endereçar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais do negócio

Requisitos

  • Domínio em Databricks
  • Experiência sólida com linguagem SQL e Python
  • Conhecimento do stack de dados Azure/AWS/GCP e técnicas de DataOps
  • Experiência com construção de fluxos de dados utilizando ferramentas de big data
  • Visão de foco no cliente e habilidade para comunicar ideias de forma clara e concisa, assim como em resolução de problemas

Sobre nós

A Five Acts valoriza a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão. Acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força impulsionadora da inovação e do crescimento. Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas.

  • Develop influential relationships within business & HR

  • Foster collaboration and information sharing

Experience Requirements

  • 5-10 years of progressive Human Resources experience

Office & Travel Requirements

  • Role is hybrid with regular presence at local client locations

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. description:
Join a High-Performance Startup Focused on Building the Future of AI-Driven Paid Acquisition Performance Marketing

At WKND, we’re not just another agency—we’re shaping a tech-driven future where AI-powered solutions revolutionize how brands acquire and retain customers. While we currently excel as a performance marketing and creative strategy firm, our long-term vision is to develop scalable software platforms that help eCommerce brands maximize their growth, profitability, and brand loyalty.

We don’t follow trends—we create them. Our approach is anchored in speed, innovation, and execution at the highest level, redefining performance and retention marketing in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

Relentless Pursuit of Excellence

At WKND, excellence isn’t optional—it’s our standard. We have cultivated a performance-first culture where outcomes reign supreme. Whether it takes three hours or three hundred, our goal remains the same: deliver world-class results with a tangible impact. Every team member is empowered to think critically, act decisively, and solve complex problems at scale. This is not a place for those seeking routine—it’s for those who thrive under pressure and are driven by transformative outcomes.

Innovation at Speed

We exist to outpace the speed of innovation in our industry. WKND’s work culture is defined by accountability, speed, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We don’t just meet expectations—we exceed them. By leveraging advanced AI and automation, we craft data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable ROI for our clients while setting new standards in acquisition and retention.

Uncompromising Standards

Our team acts with a founder’s mentality—taking full ownership of their work and upholding exceptionally high standards. Collaboration, precision, and simplicity fuel our execution. Every process we design is built to scale without unnecessary complexity, ensuring each solution is as potent as it is elegant.

Customer-Centric Mission

Our clients’ success is our driving force. We are obsessed with creating exceptional experiences that empower global DTC brands to attract, convert, and retain customers at scale. From high-performing ad campaigns and creative iterations to AI-driven marketing solutions, we’re laser-focused on delivering strategies that surpass expectations and fuel sustained growth.

Visionary Thinking

At WKND, we don’t just look at where marketing stands today—we anticipate where it’s going tomorrow. We operate with a forward-thinking mindset, exploring how AI and emerging tech will reshape both acquisition and retention strategies over the next decade. Join us in laying the foundation for the future of eCommerce growth.

This is your chance to be part of a team where excellence is non-negotiable, and rewards are directly tied to performance. If you’re ready to tackle challenges, push boundaries, and define the future of data-driven marketing, WKND is where you belong. We don’t just aim to compete—we aim to lead.

The Power of Communication

At WKND, clear, proactive communication is the backbone of our high-performance culture. We believe in staying ahead of potential issues rather than reacting after problems arise. By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. This approach fosters accountability not just within individual departments but across the entire organization—everyone owns their deliverables while working cohesively toward common objectives.

As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. This involves active listening —genuinely hearing and understanding each stakeholder’s perspective, then offering thoughtful recommendations that drive both short-term impact and long-term success. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Ultimately, this culture of open dialogue and empathy elevates everyone’s contributions—enabling us to deliver world-class outcomes at speed.

Why Join WKND?

  • Build Innovative SaaS Solutions
    Contribute to developing scalable software designed for global eCommerce markets.
  • Solve Mission-Critical Challenges
    Address complex acquisition and business challenges using AI-powered tools that drive efficiency, engagement, and ROI.
  • Pace of Innovation
    Operate at the cutting edge of AI technology, where bold thinking and agility are the keys to success.
  • Performance-Based Rewards
    Benefit from a competitive compensation structure with stock options, directly aligning your growth with our company’s trajectory.
  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
    Collaborate with a team that values meaningful outcomes over mere effort and recognizes truly exceptional results.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .
Apply now to join our high-performance team, harness AI-driven insights, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital marketing. Together, we’ll redefine eCommerce growth and achieve exceptional results for our clients.

Liferay is a uniquely profitable B2B enterprise software company with 1,000+ fiery-eyed employees all across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. Our customer roster includes global companies such as Airbus, US Bank, Honda, and Desjardins.

But we don’t just make awesome software, we are also fueled by a greater-than-profit vision. By building a vibrant business, making technology useful, and investing in communities, we make it possible for people to reach their full potential to serve others. This commitment extends beyond our product; Liferay donates 10% of our profits to charities around the world. Oh, we’re also self-funded which gives us the freedom to work on whatever we think brings the most value to customers and communities in the long run!

About You and this Role

Liferay seeks to expand its ability to empower, inspire, and influence technical practitioners and developers by producing exceptionally engaging and accessible documentation and training material. To support this effort, Liferay seeks motivated, independent, and servant-hearted Technical Writers to participate in organizing, writing, and revising documentation and training materials for our Business Process Management, Analytics Cloud and Site Management component areas.

Technical Writers work directly with their manager and technical staff to produce learning content for publication, to assess and revise existing content, and participate in tactical decision-making. This role also collaborates with other Technical Writers and with relevant Enablement and product team members. The ideal candidate has a love for technology, a passion for effective communication, is detail-oriented, independently motivated, flexible, adaptable, and a team player.

Key Objectives

  • Collaborating with Enablement leads to plan, create, and maintain product documentation, enablement courses, and other learning content for Liferay products.
  • Keeping older documentation up to date.
  • Collaborating with development leads to plan and write new documentation to capture new features, enhancements, and changes to the software as they are implemented.
  • Creating engaging developer tutorials that showcase the power and value of Liferay development.
  • Revising existing documentation to meet Liferay’s documentation standards.
  • Contributing to presentation of learning content in relevant formats: written, webinars, classroom, video narration, and more.
  • Actively engaging with the Liferay community to understand and address learning needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong verbal and written command of the English language, able to balance completeness with brevity
  • Experience in technical writing, product documentation, or online publishing
  • Experience developing educational content, such as courses, webinars, and tutorials

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Markdown, Git, and GitHub
  • Experience working at the Linux/Unix CLI
  • Ability to read and understand source code written in Java and/or JavaScript
  • Experience helping others learn highly technical topics

What We Offer

  • Salary package w/ competitive benefits according to qualifications and experience
    Opportunities to take responsibility, grow professionally, and Stay Nerdy
  • A positive and collaborative work culture
  • Working at a leading open-source company

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.
  • Monitor and document progress using HLN’s EMR system.
  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and interdisciplinary teams to coordinate care.

  • Participate in ongoing supervision, licensure support, and cross‑program initiatives.

About Abby Care: Making family care possible. At Abby Care, we are tackling one of the most important and unsolved challenges of our time: family caregiving. Over 50 million Americans are family caregivers for loved ones without pay, tools, or support. Our mission is clear and ambitious: to train and employ family caregivers so they can get paid for the care they already provide at home. Abby Care is building a tech-powered, family-first care platform to efficiently deliver care, improve health outcomes, and provide the best-in-class experience nationwide. We’re supported by top, mission-driven VCs to empower families throughout the country.

The Role

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM - 8:00 PM Eastern Time.

We’re looking for passionate and empathetic hustlers to join us. This is not your typical sales or customer success position. Instead, you’ll be working with real families with real human problems. Your role is to empower underserved families to take the most transformative step of their life to access care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the family empowerment function. You’ll be in charge of managing our family training pipeline, pushing families to reach their maximum potential and to obtain best-in-class clinical training to best care for others.
  • Uplift our families. You’ll guide families through the healthcare and training maze. You are their biggest cheerleader during the highest highs and lowest lows.
  • Partner with technology, clinical, and product teams across Abby Care. You\'ll be a critical voice for collaboration among initiatives to further our mission.
  • Build a thriving community. You will play an integral role in building out our Abby Care community, helping coordinate meet-ups, introducing families to each other, and organizing events, seminars, and conversations that empower families to rely on one another to get through the sometimes bumpy roads.

Qualifications

  • At least 1-4 years of sales or customer success experience in a professional role. This can mean (but is not limited to) you have work experience in any of the following areas:

    • Account Management
    • Customer Success Development
    • Call Center Development

  • Experience in business analytics and performance measurement (or willing to learn). You’ve used a myriad of tools spanning from spreadsheets to growth dashboards.
  • Deep empathy, endless tenacity, charisma, and patience.

  • Families First: Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”
  • Urgency with Precision: Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.
  • Relentlessly Resourceful: As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.
  • Purpose with Positivity: We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.
  • Driven to redefine What’s Possible: We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.

  • Generous paid time off: 15 days PTO plus 10 paid company US holidays.
  • Team bonding: full-time employees participate in team activities and our annual company retreat.
  • Set Up for Success: company-issued laptop provided.
  • Growth Opportunities: build leadership skills across US markets.

THE EXPERIENCE YOU WILL BRING

Experience leading and working as part of a team in a follow-the-sun support model.

Proven industry experience in Application support and capable of owning the team responsibility, with at least 7-14 years of experience in supporting capital markets solutions that process financial instruments.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Previous experience in Incident management / escalation process / change management process.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical persons with proven experience of working with business stakeholders and external clients.

Willingness to take ownership for problem resolution and additional responsibilities where applicable.

Strong scripting and programming skills.

High proficiency with Linux environments (Amazon Linux 2023, Redhat and CentOS).

Good understanding of networking and client/server technology ( websockets and ports), FIX connectivity is also a bonus.

Worked with and have an understanding of cloud computing and environments, ideally AWS hosting.

Proven industry experience following Agile Software Development practices.

Knowledge of the typical flows and functionality associated with handing business flows in one or more asset types; equities, fixed income, FX, listed future and option, OTC derivatives.

The ability to constructively participate and critique in technical and functional discussions with talented technical architects and lead developers.

Process excellence – a passion to achieve results though effective organization and process disciplines.

Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Ability to maintain confidence and composure in all situations.

Self-starter with strong sense of ownership.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware .

Overview

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. Our games are inspired by classic and modern JRPGs, blending combat, exploration, and narrative. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine, ideally Unity.
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

How to Apply

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name". Include your resume and portfolio and feel free to share any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio founded in ****, committed to creating player‑first video games that craft compelling stories and lasting experiences. We are self‑funded and early in a new JRPG project.

About Darkroom
Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

Role responsibilities
You will work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, assessing the efficacy of ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction, with a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.
  • Sales: Deliver game-changing creative ads that sell products and services.
  • Diversity: Increase creative diversity of ad programs through multiple formats: static, motion, video, UGC, AI.
  • Volume: Increase the volume of the performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with potential to scale.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team building a world-class creative advertising culture. You will work directly on our Creative Team and collaborate with our Social Commerce and Paid Media teams. Your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

What you’ll do

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, and also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into ad concepts (metrics include thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR; adapt creatives to impact these metrics).
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on asset creation (static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, storyboards). Capable of contributing directly in design tools if needed.
  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity and strategic rationale.
  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs with a focus on short-form video and static ads. If you have not produced short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.
  • A digital portfolio showing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and static assets with impact metrics.
  • Ability to storyboard, cut, and ship ads; proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong understanding of hooks, angles, metrics (thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, CPA) and how to test next.
  • Experience with tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Runway, etc., and have shipped AI-assisted creative elements.

  • Capable of turning vague goals into testable concepts and leading iterations with minimal hand-holding.
  • Strong in Figma Auto Layout and Components; proficient in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.
  • No portfolio link or no performance context.
  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.
  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom
Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A-players that want to build something great. There is no room for mediocrity. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape—world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Overview

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. Our games are inspired by classic and modern JRPGs, blending combat, exploration, and narrative. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.

Bonus Points For

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, que sempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana , tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

Seja bem-vindo (a) ao Portal de Carreiras da Santa Casa da Bahia!

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Be among the first 25 applicants. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products and services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • Proficient with macOS enterprise management; procure and deliver technology equipment.
  • Own the onboarding experience for new employees and the offboarding process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, create help articles, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues to completion; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects over sprints using Jira (agile).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.; use open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation, tickets, email, and Slack communication skills.
  • Proficiency in security practices, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and CLI experience; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We seek a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments, embodies our values, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership for Ledn employees.
  • Remote work opportunity up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Purposeful career with a focus on removing barriers to doing great work.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusivity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. All requests will be handled confidentially. We are a remote-first company with a global team. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes or related fees.

  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até o lançamento e a iteração contínua.

  • Sólida experiência como Product Owner, liderando o desenvolvimento de produtos de software em ambientes ágeis.

Desejáveis

Formação

Modelos de Trabalho

Adotamos o modelo 100% remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade, enquanto mantém a interação virtual com a equipe para garantir uma colaboração eficaz e um ambiente de crescimento contínuo.

Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, seja feliz. Nossos valores nos unem e nossas diferenças nos potencializam como um grupo. Location: Remote (Latin America, US time zones)

  • Ensure website responsiveness across all devices for a seamless and engaging user experience.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-performance team with a strong focus on growth.

Why Join Us?

  • Have a direct impact on brand visibility, lead generation, and revenue growth.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Do

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

Overview

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, inquietas, com coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira. Valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada. Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências. Na Kunumi, o design é a forma como traduzimos complexidade em sentido; ele nos ajuda a ver (e fazer os outros verem) aquilo que ainda está sendo imaginado. Procuramos uma pessoa que compreenda o design não apenas como forma ou estética, mas como uma maneira de pensar, comunicar e provocar. Alguém capaz de transformar conceitos abstratos, dados e ideias em narrativas visuais que inspirem entendimento e emoção, revelando o que há de mais humano na tecnologia que criamos. Este papel é essencial para dar corpo, cor e ritmo às histórias que contamos sobre quem somos e o impacto que queremos gerar. Do design gráfico ao digital, da apresentação à visualização de dados, o trabalho dessa pessoa tocará diretamente a forma como a Kunumi se expressa, para dentro e para fora.

  • Curiosidade e repertório estético, com olhar apurado para composição, tipografia, ritmo e cor.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com pessoas de diferentes áreas e formações.
  • Capacidade de equilibrar criação e execução, saber quando ousar e quando simplificar.

  • Vivência em ambientes de inovação, ciência de dados ou tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento de inglês que permita leitura e referência de materiais visuais internacionais.

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto. Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Leading the collection, evaluation, and processing of adverse event reports to ensure timely and accurate reporting in accordance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.
  • Conducting thorough data analysis and interpretation of safety data, identifying trends and potential safety signals that require further investigation.
  • Preparing and submitting comprehensive periodic safety update reports (PSURs) and other regulatory documents, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

title: [Template 2025] Talent Pool B2C - Future Salvador
description:
Sobre nós

XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independentes do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos com ambição de fazer o impossível.

Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance? Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos. Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. O programa conta com uma esteira de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo. Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn. Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, mantendo-se informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes, online e presencialmente.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, podendo o retorno demorar mais que outras vagas da XP. Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future para você se aplicar. Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: XP Inc. oportunidades (site) ou

Benefícios

Benefícios:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive para dependentes), plano odontológico, Wellhub (Gympass), Zenklub, seguro de vida, iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível), vale transporte, New Value (clube de benefícios), licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias, auxílio creche;
  • Vida financeira: fundos de investimentos exclusivos, assessoria de investimentos, cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anualidade, crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB imobiliário, etc.).

Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes. Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora. Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

Processo

  1. Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais: Alinhamento cultural com o teste Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. XDay: Dinâmica focada nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

  5. Entrevista com a liderança: Discussão sobre visão e contribuição para a equipe e a empresa.

  6. Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  7. Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir bom encaixe cultural.

  8. Oferta: Proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, confira o vídeo sobre o Fator XP para reconhecer nosso propósito como empresa e cultura.
