description:
Descrição da vaga

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nós destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente.

Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo nos proporcionou um amplo know‑how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Tech Lead

Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Colaborar com outras equipes (produto, design, operações) para definir requisitos e especificações técnicas. Desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas de software escaláveis e robustas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com role de Tech Lead ou liderança técnica.
  • Domínio de .NET 6+ e C#.
  • Sólida experiência com arquitetura de software (monolítica, modular e microsserviços).
  • Proficiência em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Experiência em Entity Framework Core e LINQ.
  • Vivência em APIs RESTful e gRPC.
  • Domínio em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e otimização de queries.
  • Experiência com injeção de dependência, programação assíncrona e técnicas de paralelismo.
  • Prática com Git (branching strategy, pull requests, code reviews).
  • Experiência em CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

Informações adicionais

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Nossos Pilares Culturais e Seus Atributos São

  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação.

Junte‑se à nós!

Somos nstech, a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo e estamos construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico.

Nosso objetivo é impactar a sociedade de forma positiva, reduzindo a poluição, o trânsito, as mortes nas estradas e os custos logísticos. Também impulsionamos o crescimento econômico, a equidade salarial, a diversidade e o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

Ao se juntar à nstech, você fará parte de uma equipe apaixonada por inovação, tecnologia e transformação. Terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e de grande escala, colaborando com profissionais talentosos e diversificados.

  • 6+ years of software development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a technical lead or equivalent leadership role.

  • Excellent problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong leadership, mentorship, and task delegation capabilities.
  • Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and industry trends.
  • Experience in process improvement and driving change within a team or organization.

Propósito Estratégico da Função

O Analista de Performance Comercial será responsável por integrar dados, tecnologia e estratégia comercial para elevar a eficiência e a previsibilidade dos resultados da CONTRATANTE. Sua missão é converter dados em decisões inteligentes, otimizando funis, campanhas, precificação e performance de vendas, com foco em crescimento escalável, automação e inteligência analítica.

Missão da Vaga

Ser o guardião da eficiência comercial e o motor da aceleração do crescimento institucional, transformando dados em inteligência acionável.

Atuar na análise profunda, manutenção e melhoria contínua das ferramentas de marketing e vendas (RD Station, RD Conversas, CRM e BI), garantindo dados confiáveis, relatórios consistentes e insights que gerem impacto direto nas conversões e no ROI.

Responsabilidades-Chave e Entregáveis

Business Intelligence (BI) - Criar e manter dashboards e relatórios estratégicos, com visão 360º da performance comercial. Painéis em Data Studio / Power BI atualizados e automatizados, com indicadores como CPL, CAC, ROI, Ticket Médio e Taxas de Conversão do Funil.

Análise e Diagnóstico - Monitorar a performance das campanhas e do funil de vendas, identificando gargalos e oportunidades. Relatórios semanais e mensais com diagnósticos, tendências e recomendações de ação.

Otimização de Sistemas - Garantir e aprimorar integração dos dados e a comunicação entre RD Station, RD Conversas e CRM. Auditorias de dados e relatórios de Score, corrigindo erros e duplicidades.

Inteligência Artificial - Aplicar IA para gerar previsões e segmentações avançadas (Lead Scoring, Churn, Lifetime Value). Relatórios de insights validados e aplicados em campanhas.

Governança e Auditoria - Auditar scripts de vendas, políticas de preço, segmentações e regras promocionais. Relatórios de auditoria e recomendações de alinhamento comercial e de marketing.

Suporte Estratégico - Apoiar lideranças e equipes na interpretação dos dados e implementação das decisões. Participação em reuniões executivas, apresentações e workshops de dados.

Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

  • Aumento da taxa de conversão e do ticket médio;
  • Crescimento do ROI em campanhas e aquisição;
  • Melhoria do Data Score no CRM/RD;
  • Frequência e qualidade dos relatórios entregues;
  • Implementação efetiva das recomendações analíticas;
  • Redução de gargalos e inconsistências identificadas em auditoria.

Perfil Profissional Desejado Experiência

  • Atuação comprovada em Growth, Performance Comercial ou Inteligência de Vendas;
  • Histórico de uso avançado de RD Station (Marketing e Conversas), CRM e BI (Data Studio / Power BI);
  • Vivência em educação, saúde, SaaS ou negócios digitais será considerada diferencial.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • RD Station Marketing e RD Conversas: automações, segmentações e relatórios;
  • CRM: gestão de pipeline, taxas de conversão e análise de performance;
  • BI (Data Studio / Power BI): criação de dashboards e automações;
  • Planilhas avançadas (Google Sheets): fórmulas e cruzamentos;
  • IA e Data Science: uso prático de ferramentas de IA para análise preditiva e automação.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico;
  • Clareza e didática na comunicação de dados;
  • Organização, autonomia e senso de prioridade;
  • Perfil executor com mentalidade de dono;
  • Capacidade de traduzir números em decisões.

Regime de Trabalho e Dedicação

  • Foco: Entregas com resultados, não é horas.

Overview

  • Quality Assurance: Oversee the entire release lifecycle, ensuring that all release criteria, including functionality, performance, and security requirements, are met before deployment.

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

title: Analista de IT Ops Pleno
description:
Overview

Já pensou em utilizar a tecnologia para proporcionar o avanço das melhores práticas da medicina e mais, ajudar a mudar o sistema de saúde no Brasil?

O nosso sonho é revolucionar o ambiente da saúde, tornando-a mais acessível, mais humana e simples, mas para isso, precisamos de pessoas que desafiem o status quo e pensem grande todos os dias.

Se você gosta de um ambiente com muita autonomia, de trabalhar em um ambiente que você possa se arriscar todos os dias e com as principais tecnologias do mercado, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista de IT Ops com foco em suporte e sustentação de aplicações, sua missão será garantir a estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade de nossas plataformas, atuando como a ponte essencial entre a operação e a engenharia. Você não será apenas um solucionador de problemas, mas um agente de melhoria contínua. Esperamos que você use sua expertise em software para investigar causas-raiz em um ambiente de microsserviços, desenvolver fixes, criar automações e implementar soluções com IA para otimizar nossos processos de suporte.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atuar na gestão de incidentes: Investigar problemas em nossas aplicações e suas integrações, realizando diagnóstico, investigação da causa raiz e implementação da solução do problema (solução de contorno ou solução definitiva).
  • Análise de Logs: Utilizar ferramentas de observabilidade para troubleshooting de problemas em ambientes de nuvem (GCP).
  • Desenvolver e Implementar Correções (Fixes): Atuar diretamente no código para corrigir bugs e vulnerabilidades, utilizando Git/GitHub para versionamento e participando do ciclo de deploy em produção.
  • Criar e Manter Automações: Identificar oportunidades de automação em rotinas de suporte e processos manuais, contribuindo para a eficiência do time.
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, manuais de procedimento e artigos para a base de conhecimento.
  • Apoiar na sustentação de integrações com sistemas de parceiros e fornecedores, garantindo a fluidez dos nossos processos.
  • Explorar e Aplicar Soluções de IA: Pesquisar e implementar soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial para prever falhas, otimizar o atendimento e escalar nosso suporte de forma inteligente.
  • Garantir a Saúde dos Microsserviços: Monitorar a comunicação entre serviços, investigar falhas e garantir a resiliência da nossa arquitetura distribuída.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas, principalmente Engenharia e Produto: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de engenharia para comunicar os aprendizados do suporte e influenciar o roadmap de produtos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com suporte e sustentação de aplicações web, integrações e APIs (Rest e SOAP).
  • Experiência com linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Node.js.
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais e linguagem SQL.
  • Experiência em analisar, identificar e corrigir problemas sistêmicos na causa raiz.
  • Experiência em codificar e implementar correções em produção, seguindo as melhores práticas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em versionadores de código, preferencialmente GitHub.
  • Experiência com automações (scripts, bots, etc.) para otimizar processos.
  • Experiência com Cloud.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Plataform
  • Experiência com mensageria utilizando RabbitMQ.
  • Conhecimento prático em arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento / observabilidade, preferencialmente Grafana e OpenTelemetry (Otel).
  • Conhecimento prático na utilização de IA Generativa para otimizar processos do dia a dia.

title: Student Care Manager
description:
Overview

ELVTR is a premier online education platform specializing in live courses led by top executives from globally renowned companies. Our unique approach sets us apart in the online education landscape, offering unparalleled value to our students.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a dedicated Student Care Manager to join our team. This role is pivotal in ensuring that our students receive an exceptional educational experience and are fully satisfied with the courses they enroll in. As the frontline of student interaction, you will be instrumental in fostering a supportive and engaging learning environment.

This is a full-time remote position, open to candidates located anywhere in Brazil.

Responsibilities

  • Direct Support: Engage directly with students to support their needs through phone, email, and online chats.
  • Community Engagement: Encourage and maintain student-to-student communication, fostering a supportive learning community.
  • Instructor Liaison: Ensure clear and effective communication between students and instructors.
  • Live Class Assistance: Offer real-time support to instructors and students during live classes for a seamless educational experience.
  • Issue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve student concerns, including technical issues, to ensure uninterrupted learning.

Qualifications

  • Educational Background: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communication, or a related field is preferred.
  • High Cognitive Skills: Ability to engage intellectually with our students, demonstrating a deep understanding of our sophisticated educational products.
  • Language Proficiency: Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, are mandatory.
  • Technical Skills: Must possess a broad understanding of modern online business technologies to efficiently navigate various platforms and tools integral to the role. Proficiency with Asana, CRM tools like HubSpot, Google Sheets, Zoom, and the ability to conduct minor technical troubleshooting is required.
  • Presentation Skills: You should be presentable and confident on Zoom, ready to host student meetings.
  • Time Management: Ability to manage time and resources effectively, especially in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Bonuses: We value your dedication and expertise, offering a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and a range of company perks and benefits that reflect our commitment to excellence.
  • Exciting Benefits: Gym membership reimbursements, mental health benefits, generous vacation allowance, and free access to all our courses. We believe in continuous learning, both for our customers and our team.
  • Remote work with a Flexible Schedule: The freedom to work remotely, crafting a work-life balance that fits your personal needs.
  • Collaborative Work Environment: Join a team of passionate, like-minded individuals. At ELVTR, collaboration isn't just a buzzword; it's how we grow, innovate, and excel together.

Why You Should Join ELVTR

  • Innovative and Positive Culture: Join a team of passionate individuals who are driven by a common vision.
  • Growth Opportunities: At ELVTR, we not only believe in nurturing talent but also in providing abundant opportunities for professional development. In fact, 100% of our senior managers have been promoted to executive roles from within the company.
  • A Mission You Can Be Proud of: Be part of a brand that stands for quality, innovation, and inspiring education. Be part of a company that’s changing the face of online education, connecting students with top-tier executives.

Join Us:

If you take pleasure in going the extra mile to serve and delight others, and are passionate about providing a top-tier educational experience, we invite you to apply. Your enthusiasm for customer satisfaction and your knack for resolving issues will make you an invaluable asset to our team.

Due to the high volume of applications, we will only be able to respond to candidates whom we are interested in moving forward with. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to reviewing your application.

ELVTR is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering a diverse, inclusive environment for all, whether you join us as an employee or a contractor.

Information Technology Manager at LEDN

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. $78,926.75 — $132,650 USD

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Benefits

Full time employees receive a competitive total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in Samsara domain. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues. The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short‑term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share. This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. This is a remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.

  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.

  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Our team is a passionate group from diverse backgrounds, united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and work well in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will report to the Director of IT and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams such as Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

What You’ll Do / Responsibilities

  • Be the customer-facing first line of support for employees via channels like Slack and Jira; manage end-user experience and support, primarily on macOS (we are mac-centric).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; oversee onboarding for new employees and device retrieval for departures.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and track work in Jira using agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; API experience and system-to-system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; able to handle hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in documenting solutions and writing clear help articles; security-conscious mindset (PGP familiarity).
  • Networking fundamentals and troubleshooting across OSI layers; ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficient work.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth tech environment; ability to navigate ambiguity with empathy and clarity.
  • Remote-work experience and a collaborative, cross-functional mindset.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package from day one; competitive PTO and ownership in the company via equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role with opportunities for growth and impact in the digital asset space.
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace; Ledn is an equal opportunity employer.

Additional Information

Requests for accommodation during the recruitment process can be emailed to the Ledn team; requests will be kept confidential. Our team is global, remote-first, and applications may be shortlisted for a brief video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain) • Location: Remote • Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role: We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\u2019s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English. As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Employment details

  • Type: Part-time (flexible contract)
  • Job function: Health Care Provider, Research, and Education
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

description:
About OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. We’re doing it through soda a new kind of soda: delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Our goal is to create products that support health for all and to build a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone.

OLIPOP launched in 2018 with cans that bring Ben’s vision to life as a functional soda. We aim to prove that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good and that soda can bring people together.

Join us as we write a new American soda story together—one OLIPOP at a time.

About the Role

OLIPOP is looking for an IT Manager who’s passionate about empowering teams through technology and ensuring our systems are secure, scalable, and easy to use. This role is both strategic and hands-on, leading key IT initiatives while working with tools like Microsoft 365, Zscaler, Okta, and Sophos. You’ll drive IT policy, governance, and vendor management while helping shape how technology supports OLIPOP’s growth.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Partner with the IT Director and company leadership to define and execute OLIPOP’s IT strategy, roadmap, and annual priorities.
  • Establish, document, and enforce IT policies, standards, and best practices across the organization.
  • Own IT vendor management — from sourcing to contract negotiation, renewals, and ongoing performance.

Systems & Operations

Security & Compliance

  • Lead information security initiatives, including SSO/MFA, identity governance, and zero-trust architecture through Okta and Zscaler.
  • Maintain and continually improve endpoint protection, patching, and data-loss prevention using tools like Sophos.
  • Conduct regular IT risk assessments, user-access reviews, and incident-response exercises.
  • Ensure audit readiness for ITGC, SOC 2, and SOX-related controls; support compliance with company security policies.

Project & Vendor Management

  • Lead cross-functional IT projects — migrations, tool implementations, and automation initiatives — from scoping through delivery.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with SaaS providers, MSPs, and technology partners.
  • Deliver clear project documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication.

User Experience & Support

  • Provide hands-on support and mentorship to IT staff and end-users, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Lead the transition of the IT helpdesk from external support to an internal model, establishing SLAs, processes, and escalation paths.
  • Oversee the employee onboarding and offboarding process, ensuring proper provisioning, deprovisioning, and access governance.
  • Design and deliver internal training and self-service resources to promote productivity and security awareness.
  • Support the rollout and adoption of new security tools and endpoint-management platforms.
  • Continuously assess and enhance IT service delivery through automation, monitoring, and user feedback loops.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience managing IT operations in a cloud-first, SaaS-heavy environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Zscaler, Okta, Sophos, and related modern IT and security tools.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional IT projects and vendor management from negotiation through delivery.
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, ITGC, and best practices for data protection and access management.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with enterprise business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Celigo) is a plus.
  • Experience supporting audit readiness and compliance programs (SOX, SOC 2).
  • Background managing or scaling small IT teams in high-growth environments.

REPORTS TO: Director, IT

COMPENSATION: $125k-$140k plus bonus

How We Work

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we stay close across time zones. We move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth comes from listening as much as leading. At OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together and building something with lasting impact.

What We Value

Our values shape how we show up for each other, our customers, and the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity : Everything we do ladders up to supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit : When things get messy, we get inventive and stay curious, adapting quickly to find the path forward.
  • Lead at Every Level : Leadership is about ownership. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility : We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know. We give feedback with care and grow from it.

What We’re Looking For

Success at OLIPOP comes from living our values, staying curious, and engaging with pace and purpose. We’re building something big and are looking for people who:

  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are excited by building something new and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a unique opportunity.

A instituição secular, que sempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana , tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

  • Realizar a vigilância ativa das infeções hospitalares, identificando casos, fontes e possíveis surtos.
  • Recolher, analisar e interpretar dados epidemiológicos para identificar padrões e fatores de risco.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Seja bem-vindo (a) ao Portal de Carreiras da Santa Casa da Bahia!

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Work closely with line of business leaders (in particular the Corp. Treasury Team) and subject matter experts to continuously improve the content of such documents and manage cross-references to authoritative sources and control procedures.

title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Design na Lemon

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Já viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

Experiência desejável

(não esperamos que você domine tudo valorizamos curiosidade e vontade de aprender)

  • Conhecimento em design comportamental e arquitetura da escolha;
  • Experiência na construção e evolução de Design Systems.

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (além dos feriados nacionais, você tem alguns dias no ano à sua escolha para curtir uma folguinha ou emendar o descanso antes ou depois de um feriado).

Leia aqui por favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade. Encorajamos que se candidatem pessoas com as mais diferentes histórias e vivências, pois isso nos auxilia a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Também é legal saber sobre nossos valores

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona”, seu significado é pra lá de especial e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts. A saudação Sawabona se originou no Sul da África; quando alguém comete erros, a população celebra as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez e, ao final, cumprimenta com a expressão “Sawabona” e a resposta é “Shikoba”. Sawabona significa: “Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim”. Shikoba: “Então eu sou bom e existo para você”. Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro. Se você é um profissional apaixonado por Segurança da Informação e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dedicada a construir soluções robustas e inovadoras, esta vaga é para você. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior, com foco em Application Security, ou Segurança de Produto, com conhecimentos em práticas de segurança para aplicações web, mobile e APIs. Seu papel será fundamental na nossa estratégia global de segurança, atuando com temas como security & privacy by design, jornada segura de usuários, desenvolvimento seguro de software, gestão de vulnerabilidades, testes de segurança e muito mais, tornando assim os produtos da Contabilizei cada vez mais seguros.

Como Será o Seu Dia a Dia

  • Segurança de Produto: Participe ativamente na construção e avaliação de segurança dos produtos da Contabilizei, aplicando e conduzindo melhorias de segurança junto às áreas de negócio, squads de desenvolvimento e áreas de negócio;
  • Colaboração com Desenvolvimento: Trabalhe em estreita colaboração com as squads de desenvolvimento para implementar e melhorar a estratégia de desenvolvimento seguro. Execute e melhore o programa de Security Champions;
  • Gerencie Riscos de Segurança: Atue diretamente na contenção e tratamento de vulnerabilidades e brechas de segurança dos produtos, sendo protagonista do processo corporativo de gestão de vulnerabilidades, efetuando a gestão e garantia das correções e melhorias junto aos times responsáveis;
  • Inovação Tecnológica: Avalie, implemente e gerencie ferramentas de análise de vulnerabilidades, análise de código (SAST) e análise de conformidade, com foco em garantir que não tenhamos riscos de segurança na nossa stack de tecnologia e produtos;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Atue desde a concepção dos produtos, apoiando na criação e sendo protagonista na definição dos requisitos necessários de segurança. Também, lidere a implementação da estratégia de S-SDLC na esteira CI/CD da Contabilizei;
  • Compliance e Padrões de Segurança: Trabalhe diretamente com padrões internacionais de segurança e conformidade, como NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Controls, S-SDLC, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 e etc;
  • Documentação Técnica: Realize a documentação completa dos processos relacionados a Segurança de Produto;
  • Construir planos de melhorias de segurança para produtos, definindo prioridades junto às áreas de negócios e squads de desenvolvimento, sugerindo melhorias para implementação de segurança dos produtos;
  • Realizar e acompanhar testes de segurança nos produtos Contabilizei e efetuar a gestão dos achados, garantindo a correta priorização de correção;
  • Identificar, registrar as vulnerabilidades garantindo a resolução junto aos times responsáveis;
  • Acompanhar e aprimorar rotinas de SCA, SAST e DAST dos ambientes;
  • Auxiliar as squads de desenvolvimento a identificar possíveis riscos de segurança, atuando na construção dos planos de ação e orientando-as corretamente;
  • Crie e dissemine baselines de segurança para arquiteturas e desenvolvimento seguro de software.

O Que Buscamos

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Boa comunicação e condução de temas que envolvam outros times;
  • Experiência em avaliação e condução de melhorias de segurança em produtos Web e Aplicativo Mobile, principalmente de Conta Digital;
  • Experiência com metodologias de desenvolvimento seguro, prevalecendo o security shift left e security by design, com requisitos de segurança e modelagem de ameaças;
  • Experiência com a implementação de SAST e DAST em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos com Pentest em aplicações web e API REST;
  • Conhecimento em Go, Python, Java ou Kotlin, para analisar códigos e desenvolver scripts;
  • Experiência prévia como AppSec.

description:
Overview

Ux Designer role at Memory Ware. Memory Ware is a fully remote studio focused on player-first experiences in games, with a JRPG-inspired design ethos.

We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative. You’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration. You should be able to envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You will collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

Responsibilities

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) are intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the gameplay loop and propose smart, game-genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure visual and technical execution supports usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low-fidelity prototypes.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy and ability to engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Email your resume and portfolio; include any details about yourself you’d like to share. Send your email to the address provided with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name".

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, focused on sustainably creating video games with a player-first philosophy, crafting stories and experiences that create lasting memories for players. We are a self-funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you’re eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

Location & Type

Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil — Full-time, Remote-friendly role. Seniority: Mid-Senior level.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and committed to using digital assets to democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn is an environment that aims to build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support and provide an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are all Mac.

Responsibilities

  • Proactive and reactive IT support for employees; troubleshoot using the terminal and macOS in an enterprise context.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and exit IT processes for employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.); document solutions and automate routine tasks.
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents; prioritize help desk tickets and track work in Jira using agile methods/sprints.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs expectations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong security awareness, basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Self-management skills to scope and prioritize work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line tools for efficient work.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Growth

  • We value adaptability, resilience, collaboration across functions, and empathy. We seek leaders who thrive in startup or tech environments and embrace our values.
  • Remote-friendly culture with opportunities for growth and ownership via equity.

Benefits & Equity

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership via equity; remote work opportunity up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is truly global with a remote-first environment across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. description:
Pessoa Analista de Qualidade de Software - Sênior (Remoto)

Quem somos? Quer se tornar um Youxer? Se liga, essa vaga é PJ e remota!

O que você vai fazer?

  • Analisar a documentação do projeto, como requisitos e design, para entender os objetivos e casos de uso do sistema, e assim definir a estratégia de teste mais adequada;
  • Elaborar o plano de testes com base nos requisitos do projeto, definindo objetivos, cenários, prioridades e cronograma para garantir que o software seja testado de forma completa e eficiente;
  • Criar cenários de teste detalhados, definindo as condições, ações e resultados esperados para cada teste, a fim de encontrar defeitos e garantir a qualidade do software;
  • Documentar os cenários de testes, detalhando os passos a serem seguidos para que possam ser replicados e verificados com precisão;
  • Liderar e executar testes de software complexos, utilizando ferramentas e métodos adequados para identificar defeitos e garantir que o produto final atenda aos requisitos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Treinar, capacitar e desenvolver a equipe de Analistas de Qualidade de Software em testes manuais e automatizados, novas ferramentas e metodologias ágeis, a fim de garantir a atualização contínua e a excelência técnica;
  • Analisar os resultados dos testes e documentar os defeitos encontrados, com detalhes e prioridade, para ajudar a equipe de desenvolvimento a fazer as correções;
  • Efetuar a revisão e realizar novos testes após as correções para verificar se os defeitos apontados foram corrigidos e se não afetou outra parte do sistema;
  • Elaborar testes automatizados de software, cobrindo desde testes unitários até testes de integração e ponta a ponta, criando scripts que simulam interações com a aplicação, sem a necessidade de intervenção manual, com o objetivo de detectar de forma rápida e eficiente regressões e erros, contribuindo para uma entrega mais rápida e ágil do software;
  • Elaborar manuais do usuário claros e organizados para fornecer as informações necessárias aos usuários;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e inovações em testes de software, incluindo ferramentas, metodologias e padrões, para aplicar as melhores práticas.

  • Experiência mínima de 04 anos com testes manuais (Aplicando testes regressivos, exploratórios, usabilidade, integração e performance e Planejamento dos testes, escritas em BDD (gherkin));
  • Experiência com teste automatizado;
  • Conhecimento sólido dos métodos, técnicas e processos aplicados no desenvolvimento dos trabalhos, incluindo o planejamento e estratégias de testes, criação de cenários e execução de testes;

  • Conhecimento sólido de desenvolvimento de softwares e das linguagens de programação (Cypress + Javascript; Robot Framework + Python; Selenium + Python);
  • Conhecimento intermediário de metodologias ágeis;

description:
Join to apply for the Product Manager, Lending role at Clutch

About The Role

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track.
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turn urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems.
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence: Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills: You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly. Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch: We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you’re in the seat, bring on the prompts!
